blurb: Guests take guided boat tours to see Chicago's architecture, skyline, and landmarks from the river and lake. Tours include narrated architecture river tours, skyline lake tours, fireworks tours, and water taxi services. Boats have restrooms, beverage service, and some have shaded areas.

quotes.author: Dulguun Battuya
quotes.text: Their 75min architectural tour led by guide Jill, made me fell in LOVE with Chicago city how I see the city now. She made that happen with her incredible knowledge, presentation, puns and she carried us through history smoothly. Her pace, stories, voice and everything just suited what we’re experiencing. 100% recommend this tour to everyone who is visiting.

quotes.author: Russell Kela
quotes.text: Took the architectural tour via CityPass at the N. Michigan location and we absolutely loved it. Our tour guide, Jeremy, was excellent and entertaining. If you’re looking to see the city from a unique point of view and learn about Chicago’s storied past, highly recommend this!

quotes.author: Carrie Hefton
quotes.text: Fantastic intro to the Windy City! Jim was fantastic and kept us entertained with his stories and knowledgeable about all the buildings that have made Chi Town famous. I was also happily surprised with our discounts now for the water taxi and the lake cruise, what a deal!

quotes.author: Brian Nowak
quotes.text: We loved this tour and as a tourist feel like it was a great way to start our vacation in Chicago. We got a great lay of the land. The host Jim was great and make sure everybody had a great time.
